subject.title: Track failed sync and hydration attempts

question: Should Gitcrawl accept the failure-ledger schema and `gitcrawl sync-failures --json` contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/gitcrawl/pull/90 as the product direction for this issue?
rationale: The missing behavior is confirmed and the linked PR is proof-backed, but accepting it freezes durable SQLite fields and agent-facing output semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Accept the linked ledger contract
options.body: Review and merge https://github.com/openclaw/gitcrawl/pull/90 if the schema version, fields, retry/resolved semantics, and JSON output are acceptable.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the PR to reduce or mark the public output surface as experimental if maintainers want the ledger internally before freezing JSON semantics.

options.title: Reject this ledger shape
options.body: Keep this issue open for a different design and close or replace the linked PR if the proposed table or command contract is not the desired direction.

recommendation.title: Accept the linked ledger contract
recommendation.body: Review and merge https://github.com/openclaw/gitcrawl/pull/90 if the schema version, fields, retry/resolved semantics, and JSON output are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: The broader PR-detail cache and sync hydration history most strongly points to this owner for the persisted failure-ledger contract decision.
